conduct_curriculum_autonomy_008.evidence: Teachers teaching the same subject will be covering the same skills. Each will use his own instructional techniques and procedures in presenting the same information.

conduct_lesson_plans_009.evidence: Planning of daily lessons will be required of each teacher regardless of the course taught. Individual plans for daily lessons will be completed by each teacher at least one week in advance. All weekly lesson plans must be entered on the district’s curriculum management system.
